title: Delegate Onboarding: 21-Day Technical Handoff Playbook
content:
Purpose:
This playbook is a compact, actionable guide to delegate a technical component (service/feature/scope) from an owner to a new or rotating owner over a 21-day focused handoff window. Primary audience: hiring managers, people-ops, tech leads and mentors who need a repeatable acceleration checklist for ramping contributors quickly while transferring tribal knowledge safely.

Scope and when to use this: 
- Use when someone new (new hire, internal transfer, contractor) needs to take operational ownership of an existing code area or service within ~3 weeks.
- Not for full role onboarding (30/60/90 plans still apply); this is a targeted technical handoff bundle for ownership transfer.

High-level goals (measurable):
- Owner can independently run, test, and deploy the component end-to-end by day 21.
- Owner can handle common incidents documented in runbook with <= 1 escalation by day 21.
- Knowledge transfer artifacts (short runbook, architecture sketch, key tests) committed to repo/confluence by day 14.

Roles and responsibilities:
- Outgoing owner (delegator): prepare handoff artifacts, shadow first 7 days, review final acceptance checklist.
- Incoming owner: complete tasks, log questions, present readiness demo on day 21.
- Mentor/tech lead: triage blockers, approve acceptance criteria, evaluate demo.
- People Ops / Manager: ensure schedule, approvals, cross-team notifications.

Prereqs (before day 0):
- Access checklist completed (repos, CI, cloud console, monitoring, pager rotations). If any access is missing, escalate to infra SRE owner immediately.
- Outgoing owner creates a short handoff doc stub: summary, architecture sketch, critical paths, and top 5 troubleshooting steps.

21-day timeline (accelerator cadence):
Day 0 (handoff kickoff):
- 30–45m kickoff meeting: outgoing owner, incoming owner, lead, and people-ops. Cover what "ownership" includes and known risks.
- Confirm access matrix, primary contacts, and SLOs.
- Assign initial quick-hit tasks (see tasks list).

Days 1–7 (observe and replicate):
- Incoming owner follows walkthroughs, runs the service locally and in staging.
- Pair with outgoing owner on 3 real tickets/PR reviews.
- Logging/metrics: ensure incoming can read metrics dashboards and create a simple alert change in staging.
- Daily 30-minute sync (days 1–5) to surface blockers.

Days 8–14 (operate and own small changes):
- Incoming owner owns a small bugfix or low-risk feature end-to-end (design -> PR -> deploy -> monitor).
- Add/update runbook sections: Postmortems, run commands, common fixes.
- Conduct a light tabletop incident drill (walk through what happens on alert).

Days 15–21 (validate and handoff complete):
- Incoming owner runs at least one canary deploy with mentor oversight.
- Prepare 20-minute demo: architecture, runbook highlights, incident path, and learning log.
- Outgoing owner completes acceptance checklist and signs off.

Handoff checklist (deliverables, use as sign-off):
- [ ] Short architecture diagram (png/svg) checked into docs.
- [ ] Runbook: start/stop, deploy commands, rollback steps.
- [ ] List of top 10 troubleshooting commands and locations of logs/metrics.
- [ ] Access list validated (CI, cloud, DB, secrets).
- [ ] CI pipeline health and key tests identified.
- [ ] One end-to-end change merged and deployed by incoming owner.
- [ ] Canary/monitoring configured for new owner and test alert triggered.
- [ ] 20-minute demo recorded or live and artifacts linked.
- [ ] Acceptance signoff from delegator and tech lead.

Acceptance rubric (quick grading for signoff):
- Prod runbook completeness: 0–3 (0 = none, 3 = clear, searchable, actionable)
- Independent deploy: 0–3 (0 = cannot, 3 = can deploy, rollback, and validate)
- Incident triage: 0–3 (0 = needs delegation, 3 = can lead triage)
- Codebase familiarity: 0–3 (0 = unfamiliar, 3 = can navigate and explain)
- Target to hit >= 10/12 for standard signoff; 9 borderline and requires a 1-week followup plan.

Common quick-hit tasks to accelerate ownership (pick 2–3 in week 1):
- Fix a low-risk flaky test and land a unit test improvement.
- Update a dashboard to add a missing metric and explain why it matters.
- Triage a non-critical 24-hour alert and write the postmortem note.
- Small perf tweak with measurable change in staging.

Delegation matrix (who to contact for what):
- CI failures: Release Eng (release-eng@redwood.com)
- Infra/network: Platform Engineering on-call
- Auth/secrets: Security & Compliance (sec-ops)
- Customer-impacting incidents: SRE pager + Manager escalation

Templates (paste into emails / PR description):
- Handoff kickoff invite subject: "[Handoff] {component} — 21d kickoff — {incoming} <-- {outgoing}"
- PR description snippet: "Ownership transfer: incoming owner {name}. Goals: small fix -> merge -> canary -> monitor. See handoff doc: {link}."

Quick DRIs for people-ops/manager:
- Ensure calendar invites created and blocked time for paired work (2x 1hr blocks/week for first 2 weeks).
- Make a Slack channel (private) for handoff Qs and link to artifacts.
- Confirm one formal check-in at day 14 and a closing demo at day 21.

Risk log (examples to include in doc):
- Missing keys or limited cloud console access (mitigation: ticket to infra and temporary scope).
- Outgoing owner leaves mid-handoff (mitigation: escalate to lead + temporary buddy).
- High-severity incident during handoff window (mitigation: freeze non-essential changes and extend window).

Open questions / unresolved items (notes to self):
- Should day 21 demo be recorded and archived in a central "team handoffs" page? (pros: searchable, cons: stale quickly)
- Playbook for multi-component handoffs (when to split into parallel 21-day micro-handoffs).

References and links:
- Confluence core handoff template: confluence:ONBOARD-312
- SRE runbook conventions: confluence:SRE-RUNBOOKS
- Example repo with handoff artifacts: github.com/redwood-inference/example-handoffs

Appendix: Mentor checklist for review (short):
- Reviewed incoming owner runbook edits? Y/N
- Watched incoming owner run the staging deploy? Y/N
- Confirmed incoming owner can escalate to the right pager? Y/N
- Final rubric score: __ /12

Notes to future editors: keep this file short and checklist-first. If you expand, put long-form narratives in Confluence and keep this doc as the practical sprint-oriented handoff kit.

Document history (selected):
- 2025-11-02 created by Asha Kapoor (playbook sketch)
- 2025-11-09 feedback from Miguel Santos (added quick-hit tasks)
- 2025-12-01 updated acceptance rubric and templates (PR link included)

End of document.
